mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO reim_subsidy_calendar (subsidy_id, subsidy_date, day_of_week, meal_standard, transport_standard, phone_standard, is_meal_selected, is_transport_selected, is_phone_selected, meal_apply_amount, transport_apply_amount, phone_apply_amount, creation_time) VALUES
(#{item.subsidyId}, #{item.subsidyDate}, #{item.dayOfWeek}, #{item.mealStandard}, #{item.transportStandard}, #{item.phoneStandard}, #{item.isMealSelected}, #{item.isTransportSelected}, #{item.isPhoneSelected}, #{item.mealApplyAmount}, #{item.transportApplyAmount}, #{item.phoneApplyAmount}, NOW())

update.foreach: UPDATE reim_subsidy_calendar SET is_meal_selected = #{item.isMealSelected}, is_transport_selected = #{item.isTransportSelected}, is_phone_selected = #{item.isPhoneSelected}, meal_apply_amount = #{item.mealApplyAmount}, transport_apply_amount = #{item.transportApplyAmount}, phone_apply_amount = #{item.phoneApplyAmount} WHERE id = #{item.id}

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_meal_selected = 1 THEN c.meal_apply_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS meal_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_transport_selected = 1 THEN c.transport_apply_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS transport_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_phone_selected = 1 THEN c.phone_apply_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS phone_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_meal_selected = 1 THEN c.meal_apply_amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_transport_selected = 1 THEN c.transport_apply_amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_phone_selected = 1 THEN c.phone_apply_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS subsidy_total FROM reim_subsidy_calendar c INNER JOIN reim_subsidy s ON c.subsidy_id = s.id WHERE s.main_id = #{mainId}
